title: Common providers: Bulgaria
coverage: Partial. Covers the three national operators, the network company behind Yettel and the research network; business ISPs are thin and local networks are not listed.
missing: Local cable and LAN internet providers (several hundred)
Most business ISPs: only three are listed; the regulator's register is in Bulgarian and was not read
An AS number for Yettel Bulgaria (its registry record holds none; its network is CETIN Bulgaria's)
The website of Novatel (it refused an automated request)
Names in Cyrillic, except the two found on the providers' own pages

sources.name: CRC (Communications Regulation Commission): registers
sources.terms: The page was requested on the read date; its reuse terms were not read (they are in the national language), so nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page answered on the read date. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in Bulgaria
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 1 of 9 entries were found on the page, by their name or a distinctive other name.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Bulgaria
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 1 of 9 entries were found on the page, by their name or a distinctive other name.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 8 of 9 websites answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty (Novatel). No support or status page was checked.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 13 AS numbers confirmed, each announced on the read date; a number whose holder was another company is listed only where the note says whose it is.

sources.name: RIPE Database (RIPE NCC): organisation and aut-num objects
sources.terms: The RIPE Database terms were not re-read for this pack; it is treated like RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to find which AS numbers an organisation holds.
sources.result: Read to find candidate AS numbers; each was then confirmed as above.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Vivacom; A1 Bulgaria; Yettel Bulgaria; CETIN
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Cited for dates and names (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Read on the date above: the former names of the three operators, and that the networks of the Yettel operators were split off into CETIN companies.

providers.name: Vivacom
providers.notes: Fixed and mobile. AS43205 (Bulsatcom), AS43561 (Net1) and AS34569 (Networx) are registered to Vivacom.

providers.name: Yettel Bulgaria
providers.notes: Mobile and fixed. Its network is CETIN Bulgaria's (AS29244, recorded there).

providers.name: CETIN Bulgaria
providers.notes: The network company behind Yettel; wholesale. AS29244 carries the AS name TelenorBG.

providers.name: BREN
providers.notes: The national research and education network.
